provenance.detail: Workbook coefficients are least-squares quadratic fits over the 3-4 tabulated Q-H / Q-η points of Таблица Д.1, not passport curves: workbook applies them as 'по ур-ю линии тренда' (Расчет рабочих точек B53). Verified numerically 2026-11-02: ЦНСА 40-1000 family fit residual ≤0.6 m at every tabulated point; ЦНСА 63-1400 family ≤11.6 m; ЦНСА 80-1400 family ≤24.4 m (largest at Q=80-96 mid-range); eta fits match the shared per-size eta points in Д.1 (eta is identical across trims because the source table itself lists one eta per size). The trim-step 'deltas' come from the source table (stages removed), not from synthetic generation.
provenance.not_manufacturer_passport: Таблица Д.1 is a normative energy-consumption appendix (Татнефть ЕРБ): values are stated 'без учета производственных отклонений по напору и КПД и носит информационный характер' (footnote 2, p.201). Treat as engineering reference, not installed-pump passport.
provenance.experimental_files_do_not_prove_characte: A045/A046 contain only field measurements; A046 reuses the same polynomials as 'должный' values, it does not derive them.

speed_note: 3000 rpm is contextual INFERENCE only, not verified: Д.1 has no rpm column; motor types (СТДМ-630/-1250, 4АРМ, ВАО 2-pole synchronous/asynchronous class) and the workbook's own n=3000 input for its ЦНС aggregates are consistent with nominal 3000 rpm but do not prove it. The workbook applies polynomials at fixed rated speed with no affinity-law rescaling (ГНУ rows are even used at 4104 rpm via a gearbox without recalculation). Do not apply to frequency-controlled operating points without explicit scaling rules.

ЦНС 180-1422.naming_caveat: Source name is АЦНС 180-1422; OPU label 'CNS180-1422(-1)' binds only if the installed aggregate is the АЦНС 180-1422 type. Suffix = stages removed per source footnote, so '-1' = 10 stages.

opu_model_bindings.naming_caveat: Per Таблица Д.1 footnote 1 (p.201): suffix -1/-2/-3 = one/two/three stages removed from the base pump; e.g. ЦНС 63-1400-3 = ЦНС 63-1400 with 10 of 13 stages. Workbook 'ЦНС' rows match Д.1 'ЦНСА' rows numerically (points identical), so the labels are the same aggregate family. Stage counts in Д.1 confirm: 63-1400 base 13 ст, -1 12 ст, -2 11 ст, -3 10 ст; 80-1400 same 13→10; 40-1000 9→6.

limitations: Coefficients are least-squares quadratic fits of normative points in ЕРБ 2499-2023 Приложение Д Таблица Д.1 — an engineering reference, NOT approved manufacturer passport data; the table itself states values are informational, 'без учета производственных отклонений по напору и КПД'.
Fit residuals vs tabulated points: ≤0.6 m (40-1000), ≤11.6 m (63-1400), ≤24.4 m (80-1400, mid-range); exact tabulated points are preferable where available.
Eta coefficients are shared across all trim variants of a pump size because Д.1 lists one eta per size; eta is only a per-size approximation.

Nominal 3000 rpm is contextual inference (СТДМ/4АРМ motor class + workbook n=3000 input); Д.1 has no rpm column, so speed is unverified — do not extrapolate in Q or rescale in n without explicit rules.
The source Q range is the fit domain, not necessarily the recommended operating zone (48 vs 60 m³/h).
Suffixes -1/-2/-3 verified = stages removed (Д.1 footnote p.201); binding to an installed aggregate still requires confirming its stage count/nameplate.
ЦНС 180-1422(-1) is absent from the workbook but present in Д.1 rows 10-13 as АЦНС 180-1422 — tabulated points recorded in verification_2026-11-02; binding needs nameplate confirmation (АЦНС vs ЦНС).

No extrapolation or nominal-parameter correction performed. Engineering reference points and provenance were added to four active passport records; manufacturer/installed-pump and rounded-polynomial approval remain pending.
